mapper.insert: insert into token_usage_log (user_id, session_id, provider, model_name, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, request_type) values (#{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{provider}, #{modelName}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{requestType})
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(total_tokens), 0) from token_usage_log where create_time >= #{startTime} and create_time < #{endTime}
select coalesce(sum(total_tokens), 0) from token_usage_log where create_time >= #{startTime} and create_time < #{endTime}

select provider, model_name as modelName, coalesce(sum(total_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) as inputTokens, coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) as outputTokens from token_usage_log where create_time >= #{startTime} and create_time < #{endTime} group by provider, model_name order by totalTokens desc
select count(distinct user_id) from token_usage_log where create_time >= #{startTime}
select coalesce(sum(total_tokens), 0) from token_usage_log where create_time >= #{startTime} and create_time < #{endTime}

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as `date`, coalesce(sum(total_tokens), 0) as totalTokens from token_usage_log where create_time >= #{startTime} and create_time < #{endTime} group by `date` order by `date`
